## Cookie.getExpiryInfo() method

Explains how this cookie's expiry was determined, for debugging purposes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getExpiryInfo(): CookieExpiryInfo | undefined;
```
**Returns:**

[CookieExpiryInfo](./tough-cookie.cookieexpiryinfo.md) \| undefined

## Remarks

- Recording must have been requested when the cookie was parsed or stored (via `recordExpiryInfo` on [ParseCookieOptions](./tough-cookie.parsecookieoptions.md) or [SetCookieOptions](./tough-cookie.setcookieoptions.md)<!-- -->); otherwise `undefined` is returned.

- The returned object is a plain, JSON-serializable snapshot with all timestamps as ISO-8601 UTC strings, so it is safe to log and is independent of the local machine's timezone.

- The diagnostics never affect the cookie itself: [Cookie.cookieString()](./tough-cookie.cookie.cookiestring.md)<!-- -->, [Cookie.toString()](./tough-cookie.cookie.tostring.md)<!-- -->, and [Cookie.toJSON()](./tough-cookie.cookie.tojson.md) are unchanged, and the information is not serialized (it does not survive [Cookie.clone()](./tough-cookie.cookie.clone.md) or a `toJSON`<!-- -->/`fromJSON` round-trip).
